name: Tempest
effect: Everyone moves 20% faster, and every 20 seconds lightning lights the whole realm for a second.

name: Deep sleep
effect: Every 20 seconds each guard dozes for 3 seconds; flowers muffle footsteps. The doze is a stun, and the muffling makes a step one gait quieter.

name: Ghost tide
effect: Knocked-out characters drift back to where they entered the realm instead of being caught (Knockout, 7.3). The drift ends on the landing tile, at the revive health.

name: Fair lights
effect: Floating lights form illusions of crew members that draw guards away. It takes its neighbours’ twenty seconds: one illusion every 20 seconds.

name: Iron bell
effect: Every step echoes: guards hear 2 tiles further but see 2 tiles less.

name: Mirage
effect: Anything moving appears one tile from where it really is. A moving character is shown on the tile it just left.

name: Clockwork
effect: Every 15 seconds all wards in the realm trigger together. Every triggered ward fires, whoever is near it.

name: Wild hunt
effect: Anyone running makes no noise at all.

name: Hidden garden
effect: Tall grass spreads one tile a minute across the realm. Each minute it spreads to every bare tile beside grass.

name: Lantern festival
effect: Lanterns heal anyone in their light, and each character returns once at the revive health, 30% of its role's health (Revival, 7.3; 12.20). The lanterns need Soul lanterns, which ship after launch, so at launch only the return plays.

name: Quicksand
effect: A few tiles become hidden pits that drop anyone a level. A few is three, and a pit costs a landing’s noise and a second.

name: Rebound
effect: Every stun bounces on to the nearest enemy. It bounces within a chain’s three tiles.
